text: Other cluster heads that are speaking in German or whatever, they will not disturb each other. Okay, so the trick here is to assign two different conversations that may happen in the same room, so using the same frequencies, and at the same time, different codes so that they do not interfere with each other. And these codes are essentially like languages for us. So that's the idea in Leech, and Leech works quite well. That's why it has been as I was saying, used in many proprietary solutions. However, it has got also some drawbacks. Okay, so we need to always look at these technologies and see. Okay, we have good ideas, but what are the drawbacks? Because there is always a drawback. Unfortunately. Well, an important drawback is that, as we said, Leech relies on the use of cluster-based topologies, where cluster heads have to collect the data from the ordinary nodes that are part of their cluster, and they need to be also able to communicate with other cluster heads. Right? So what does it mean? It means that cluster heads are going to be very busy. So can they go to sleep? No, because if the cluster head goes to sleep, the cluster, the whole cluster will not work. Okay, so the cluster head has got a very important role, responsibilities.
